title: Descent of exact-sections principal reduction through derived roofs
statement: In the setup [lem-pod-derived-reduction-sheaf-resolution-independence], suppose R is a domain and t≠0. The exact section functors G,G′ and the derived quotient functors L,T have a natural isomorphism G⋙L≅T⋙G′ on the entire unbounded derived category.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat model P_X and an isomorphism QP_X≅X for every derived object X. Its alpha comparison is invertible.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Represent any map QP→QP′ by a right roof. Resolve its source by another flat-term K-flat complex. Apply resolution-independence naturality to both chain maps in the resulting roof, then cancel the invertible denominator. This proves naturality for every derived arrow.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Transport the alpha comparisons through the chosen object isomorphisms and assemble them with NatIso.ofComponents. The roof calculation proves the required naturality equation.
